Thanks for the tag, Ben. Alyssa — copied my legal notes below (high level) and I’ve attached a tracked-redline for the MSA.

High-level legal notes:
- Term/proration: We can support a 12-month committed term, but want clarity on proration if Helio ramps mid-billing-cycle. Language in Section 2A should define monthly proration and a mid-term capacity amendment process.
- Pricing: If we keep base per-token pricing for 12mo, we’ll request a one-time implementation credit be removed (we typically use a 24mo to justify onboarding discounts).
- Data & audit: Add a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) clause limiting retention to customer-directed retention periods; audit rights should be scoped to SOC2 evidence and on-site audits require 30 days' notice.
- SLA credits: Cap on credit liability is 3 months' fees; we can offer service credits per incident up to that cap. Also suggested clarifying the definition of "downtime" vs. "degraded performance" for credentialed remediation.
- Indemnity & confidentiality: small carveouts requested around open-source model ops; we will keep standard mutual indemnity but propose an exception for model output IP disputes.

Attached: MSA_redline_KP_20290502.docx (tracked changes).

Requested before we finalize: Alyssa — can you confirm preferred billing cadence and whether Helio requires Net30? Also please share procurement contact and signer name so we can populate the signature block and expedite DocuSign prep.

If you’re ok with the above I can fold the order form changes (term, capacity, billing cadence) into the redline and provide an updated PDF.

-Kim
